# meok-emerald-tablet-mcp

> The 13 sentences of Hermes Trismegistus (Tabula Smaragdina) as the MEOK sovereign attestation protocol. Each sentence becomes a tool. Public-domain text + sovereign mapping.

**Install:** `pip install meok-emerald-tablet-mcp`
**Run:** `python -m server.py`
**By:** MEOK AI Labs (nicholas@meok.ai) · [meok.ai](https://meok.ai)

## What it does

The Emerald Tablet is the 13-sentence foundation text of Western hermetic philosophy (~800 CE Latin, based on much older Greek/Arabic originals). MEOK's attestation pipeline already has 13 sigil emission steps. This MCP names them.

## Tools (15 total)

13 sentence tools + 2 helper tools:

| # | Tool | Tablet sentence (excerpt) | MEOK step |
|--:|------|---------------------------|-----------|
| 1  | `tablet_01_verify`     | "True without falsehood, as above so below" | scope ↔ claim |
| 2  | `tablet_02_one`        | "All arose from One, by mediation of One" | parent chain |
| 3  | `tablet_03_four`       | "Sun father, Moon mother, Wind carried, Earth nurse" | kid, ts, payload, scope |
| 4  | `tablet_04_anchor`     | "Father of all perfection" | root anchor |
| 5  | `tablet_05_sig`        | "Force entire if converted into earth" | sig → artifact |
| 6  | `tablet_06_validate`   | "Separate subtle from gross" | validation gate |
| 7  | `tablet_07_two`        | "Ascends from Earth to Heaven, descends again" | ingest/audit flow |
| 8  | `tablet_08_public`     | "Glory of whole world, obscurity flies" | public verify URL |
| 9  | `tablet_09_ed25519`    | "Strong fortitude of all fortitudes" | Ed25519 + BFT |
| 10 | `tablet_10_sovereign`  | "By Will, Word, Power of the One Craftsman" | single signer |
| 11 | `tablet_11_three`      | "Hermes Trismegistus — three parts of philosophy" | King+Queen+Witness |
| 12 | `tablet_12_coagulatio` | "Operation of the Sun is complete" | release artefact |
| 13 | `tablet_13_genesis`    | "So the world was created" | genesis release |
| —  | `tablet_list_all`      | List all 13 sentences + MEOK mappings | — |
| —  | `tablet_full_text`     | Return the full canonical text | — |

## Use cases

- **Doc generator:** call `tablet_full_text` → drop into a deck or blog post
- **Audit pipeline explainer:** each tool returns the sovereign mapping for one step
- **BFT council template:** the 13 sentences = the 13 voters (quorum 7)
- **Brand spine:** "CSOAI is the Philosopher's Stone" lands harder when the 13 steps have names
